tasks.label: Shake bottle (default)
tasks.name: shake_bottle
tasks.goal: Shake the bottle with proper arm.
tasks.desc: Shake the bottle steadily using the selected arm mode.
tasks.steps: step1: reach and grasp the bottle; step2: lift it slightly; step3: shake it steadily; step4: place it back safely.

splitter.notes: Single-task episode; no automatic splitter rule yet.

tasks.label: Place bottle into paper box
tasks.name: place_bottle_in_paper_box
tasks.goal: Place the bottle into the paper box with proper arm.
tasks.desc: Pick up the bottle and place it accurately inside the paper box using the selected arm mode.
tasks.steps: step1: reach and grasp the bottle; step2: lift the bottle; step3: move it above the paper box; step4: place it into the box and release.

splitter.notes: For long continuous recordings, split when the robot grasps near the initial bottle position; this segment is interpreted as placing the bottle into the paper box.

tasks.label: Take bottle out from paper box
tasks.name: take_bottle_out_of_paper_box
tasks.goal: Take the bottle out from the paper box with proper arm.
tasks.desc: Use the selected arm to grasp the bottle in the paper box, take it out, and place it back near the start region. This is intended for continuous in-and-out collection with one long recording.
tasks.steps: step1: reach to the bottle inside the paper box; step2: grasp the bottle; step3: lift and move it out of the paper box; step4: place it near the start region and release.

splitter.notes: For long continuous recordings, split alternating backward segments as taking the bottle out from the paper box.

splitter_config.notes: The bottle in/out splitter classifies valid grasps as alternating forward/backward segments: place_bottle_into_paper_box, then take_bottle_out_of_paper_box.
